Name: Oarfish
Author: ADMantoine
Description:
[size=3]This mod brings my favorite fish and food to the game, only that ![/size]


﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/4tT1sDA.png[/img]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/bgsoQqR.png[/img]﻿

[b]Oarfish can be caught on Spring 6:00 AM - 1:00 PM in the ocean on sunny days.[/b][left][/left]
They make for a good challenging fish for the early birds and a good reason to visit the beach during this season.
Selling value at default quality and profession is 475g, making it one of the most profitable fish and enjoyable for the late-game...
o(a)r an excellent early income for players that goes the fishing route at the start; if you can aim for [b]7+ fishing proficiency[/b] to encounter them !

In Fish Ponds, they will either produce [b]1-2 Roe[/b] (57%) , 1 [b]Curiosity Lure[/b] (3+ population, 29%) or 3 [b]Fairy Roses[/b] (6+, 14%)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S6ZAovI.png[/img]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/OTY15le.png[/img]

[b]The recipe for Fishsticks is unlocked at Fishing Level 7 (right on time to find them), made with Oarfish & Mayonnaise.
[/b]
It gives +2 Fishing and +1 Speed for 9:20 min, not your usual combo but their lastly duration gives each effect an enjoyable flipside.


[b]The more you know :
[/b]
[list]
[*]Curiosity Lures considerably increase your chances to find them, consider using the Bait Maker too
[*]A new [i]secret fishable gift[/i] got added somewhere on the Beach...
[*]Should be compatible with all mods that add fishes ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SV: Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url]﻿, etc...)
[*]And with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]﻿, if further fish-mod related compatibilities are required please let me know
[*]The Beach Farm has Oarfish as well
[*][i][i]This is my first Stardew mod ~[/i][/i]
[/list]
